Name: (AT) ANGRY MACHINES
Author: Campaigner
Description:
===========
ANGRY MACHINES
===========
This is a silly resource pack that gives your big craftables a less than happy appearance. Heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55646]eltolinde's OmniCrusher remodel[/url], I called it an angry machine on the official Discord, and it made me want to make some machines look angry so that I could have MORE angry machines. 

Right now, it only covers the Furnace and Heavy Furnace. I do plan to do more, once I think of something for them. For now, ANGRY FURNACE AND ANGRY HEAVY FURNACE!

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and the Paint Bucket and provides to select these appearances.
